_meta.description: Medical awareness calendar for The Doc Mirror Topical Content Intelligence Engine (Feature 13). Each entry is tagged with specialties that should run a campaign during that observance, plus regions (US, IN, GLOBAL). The weekly cron uses this to surface the right campaign to each subscriber.

tagging_rules.specialty_tags: Use lowercase, single-word where possible. Multi-word use underscores. Always include 'general_practitioner' if applicable (most public-health observances apply to GPs).
tagging_rules.region_tags: US, IN, GLOBAL — GLOBAL means relevant for any region
tagging_rules.day: 1-31 for fixed dates; null for whole-month observances
tagging_rules.campaign_theme: Short evocative campaign name doctors can use in social posts

_meta.source_notes: Compiled from WHO observances, CDC awareness calendar, Ministry of Health (India) observances, and common specialty-society campaigns.
